name: Yume Theme Pack
summary: Extra colour themes for the Theme Engine.
description: Adds accent and base combinations to the ones built into Settings → Appearance. A theme is pure data — a base, an accent colour and a name — so this extension declares no permissions at all: it reaches no network, reads no ids and stores nothing. It is the smallest useful thing an extension can be, and a working reference for anyone writing their own pack.

include_light.description: Offer the light-base themes as well as the dark ones.
